title: Missing moeb tool: Bash (delete file, rename file for catalogue migration)
description: Used Bash (PowerShell) to migrate 94 catalogue signal files from identity-key filenames to UUID-based filenames in .moeb/signals/catalogue/. Operations included copying each file to its UUID name and deleting the old identity-key-named file. No moeb equivalent for file deletion or bulk rename exists; the spec explicitly acknowledged this and instructed buffering a MissingMoebTool signal.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a moeb delete_file tool and/or rename_file tool covering file deletion and renaming operations. These tools would allow catalogue migration and cleanup tasks to be performed without external Bash invocations.
